justification: Changes what the DCP tab and property summary show users about corner lots; frontend only plus the page check

falsifiable_check.command: jest __tests__/lib/geometry/corner-status.test.ts; pytest tests/test_page_integrity_checks_data.py -k corner; page check C4 corner_lot on fresh captures
falsifiable_check.fails_when: a corner-only row is shown on a measured non-corner lot without the note (C4 corner_lot > 0), or a failed road check is shown as 'not a corner'
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On origin/main the live DCP tab at 57 Edward St Bankstown (measured not a corner) lists 'secondary_street_setback 3.0 [secondary street or corner allotment]' with no note: page check C4 corner_lot = 11 of 20 pages (live capture 2026-10-19). The new C4 tests: unmarked row red, marked row green, failed road check green.

pre_impl.existing_data: propertyData.cornerLot from the road corridor query; DCP rows from /api/dcp/structured-controls
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: a corner-only row whose condition does not mention corner or secondary street stays unmarked (as today)

falsifiable_check.command: jest __tests__/lib/geometry/corner-status.test.ts; pytest tests/test_page_integrity_checks_data.py -k corner; page check C4 corner_lot on fresh captures

functions.name: cornerStatus
functions.input: CornerLotResult from the road corridor query
functions.output: corner, not_corner or unknown for the DCP tab and summary
functions.if_none: null, an error or confidence below 1 all return unknown

functions.name: row_fits_lot
functions.input: one captured assessment page with its API calls
functions.output: C4 flags for rows that do not fit this lot
functions.if_none: missing property route means corner rows are not examined

values.if_missing: no rendered DCP text means rows are judged unmarked (red)

break_it.scenario: road check fails and the lot is really a corner
break_it.what_happens: corner rows would be marked as not applying to a corner lot
break_it.how: only a measured not_corner marks rows; error or confidence 0 is unknown
break_it.repro: jest corner-status.test.ts 'a failed road query is unknown'

break_it.scenario: state-road row matched as a corner row
break_it.what_happens: a real 10 m state-road rule would be marked as not applying
break_it.how: pattern needs corner or secondary street/road/frontage
break_it.repro: jest corner-status.test.ts state and regional roads -> false

break_it.scenario: road map slow on every try
break_it.what_happens: the page waits up to 45 s for the corner answer
break_it.how: accepted: three tries 10/15/20 s, then the plain-words 'could not reach' sentence
break_it.repro: block portal.spatial.nsw.gov.au and load an address

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — 57 Edward St Bankstown DCP tab shows the corner note on the secondary street row
